description: Ohio Pumpkin LLC is a independent farm in 10558 N Elyria Road, OH. It grows Strawberries, Blackberries, Apples, Peaches, and Nectarines, with seasonal availability through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
